Definition: from G4862 and G2955; to stoop altogether, i.e. be completely overcome by:--bow together.
BiblicalUsage: There is a woman who has a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and is bowed together, and can in no wise lift herself up. Eighteen years bent double, and no one can straighten her but Jesus, who lays His hands on her and makes her straight.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jesus still straightens those who have been bowed together for years, and I believe no infirmity is too long for His touch.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
